title: Rachana Data Protocol v1: keyed row patch and its stream frames
description: The root is the patch, the data of an rdp.<table> message (PROTOCOL.md section 8.1). $defs holds the frames of the events wire protocol v1 the Data Protocol fixes conventions for (section 8.2); the events design is the authority for the frames, this file only for the conventions. A key is always a list of key values in key order.

reset.description: Present and an array: replaces every row. Null or absent: no reset.

total.description: A windowed subscription (section 16): the reader's row count after this patch.

top.description: A windowed subscription with top: keys of rows to insert at the top of the reader's page.

window.description: A windowed subscription (section 16, can: changes.window): the keys the reader's page shows, and whether that page starts at the first row of the table's own order.

subFrame.description: Client to server. after maps the stream (the topic) to the position the reader holds.

epoch.description: Present on messages of the minimal SSE form, where there is no subd to say it.

first.description: A conflated message (PROTOCOL.md 8.4): the first seq it merges.

expired.description: The host took the table away (PROTOCOL.md section 16): reading again answers rdp.table.unknown with expired.
